steps.what: Specify, coordinate, or conduct quality control procedures.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the quality procedure already stored. The engineering technician specifies, coordinates, or conducts the quality control or quality assurance program. The stored text does not conduct the program and does not pass a unit. Only the procedure the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A unit was marked passed because a procedure title was open, and the check had not been done.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored procedure can be opened. Specifying, coordinating, and conducting it still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A defect the procedure does not name still has to be caught by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician conducts the program. The stored text is not the result.
tasks.altitude: The quality work stays with the technician. The procedure is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Follow a procedure this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A checklist title is not the result.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored quality procedure is a lookup. It does not specify, coordinate, or conduct the program.
Filing a procedure before the technician accepts that version would store a program nobody conducted.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The procedure id already stored. The screen does not mark a unit passed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the procedure. Do not mark a result the technician has not produced.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether quality control and quality assurance share one procedure record.
research_questions: Who may accept a procedure that changes how a unit is passed?

already_counted.description: Specifying, coordinating, and conducting the quality program stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop procedures whose program record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: procedure id and the text the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still specifies, coordinates, or conducts the quality control or quality assurance program. Only opening a procedure that was already stored, and filing the procedure already accepted, is removed. A checklist title saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored part demand and the inventory count.
Procure parts and maintain the inventory documentation.

tasks.design: The {ERP} shows the part demand and the inventory count already stored. The engineering technician procures the part and maintains the related documentation. The count does not place the order, and a part id that is missing is not invented. Only the documentation the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A part was marked ordered because the count was low, and nobody had procured it.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored demand and count can be opened. Procurement and the documentation still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A part the catalogue does not list still has to be found by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician procures the part and keeps the documentation. The count is not the order.
tasks.altitude: Procurement stays with the technician. The documentation is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Place an order this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A low count is not an order.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored demand and inventory count is a lookup. It does not procure a part or write the documentation.
Filing documentation before the technician accepts that version would store an order nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The part id, the demand, and the inventory count already stored. A missing part id stops the screen from naming a part. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the demand and the count. Do not invent a part or send an order.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether demands and inventory counts share one record.
research_questions: Who may procure a part that is not on the stored demand?

already_counted.description: Procuring the part and maintaining the documentation stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop demands whose part record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: part id, demand, and the documentation the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still procures the parts and still maintains the inventory documentation. Only opening a demand and a count that were already stored, and filing the documentation already accepted, is removed. A low count saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored control requirement for this drawing.
Produce electronics drawings for industrial control networks.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the requirement already written for the industrial control, instrumentation, sensor, or telecommunications network. The engineering technician produces the electronics drawing or other graphic in the drawing tool. The requirement is not the drawing. The tool's runtime is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A title block was copied into a new file and treated as the network drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored requirement can be opened. Producing the drawing still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A network the requirement does not describe still has to be drawn by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician produces the drawing. The requirement is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: Drawing stays with the technician. The tool's runtime is not this labour.

reach.task: Take a drawing this technician produced.
reach.learn: A requirement title is not the drawing.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored requirement is a lookup. It does not produce an electronics drawing or a network graphic.
Time a drawing tool already spends opening a file is not the technician's drawing labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The requirement id already stored. The screen does not draw the network. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the requirement. Do not treat a title block as the drawing.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether control, instrumentation, and telecommunications drawings share one requirement type.
research_questions: Who confirms the requirement is the one for this network?

already_counted.description: Producing the drawing or graphic stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop requirements whose network record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still produces the electronics drawing or graphic for the control, instrumentation, sensor, or telecommunications network. Only opening a requirement that was already written is removed. The drawing tool's runtime saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored building and the current schematic.
Design or modify engineering schematics for electrical distribution.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the building record and the current schematic for the transmission, distribution, or installation. The engineering technician designs or modifies the schematic. The stored sheet is not the new design. The drawing tool's runtime is not this time. Only the schematic the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A schematic from another building was filed as the design for this one.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored schematic can be opened. The design and the modification still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A building the record does not describe still has to be designed by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician designs the schematic. The stored sheet is not that design.
tasks.altitude: The design stays with the technician. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use a schematic this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A building id is not the schematic.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored schematic is a lookup. It does not design or modify the electrical system.
Filing a schematic before the technician accepts that version would store a design nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The building id and the current schematic already stored. The new design is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the current schematic. Do not treat the drawing tool's runtime as the design.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether residential, commercial, and industrial buildings share one schematic record.
research_questions: Who confirms the schematic matches the building now being designed?

already_counted.description: Designing or modifying the schematic stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop schematics whose building record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: building id and the schematic the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still designs or modifies the engineering schematic for the transmission, distribution, or building installation. Only opening a schematic that was already stored, and filing the schematic already accepted, is removed. The drawing tool's runtime saves none of that design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering technician still conducts the quality work, still procures the part, still produces the drawing, and still designs the schematic. A stored row can be opened. It does not do that work.
reach: Inspectors use a procedure this technician has accepted, and a template is not the program.
Drafters see a schematic only after this technician has accepted it.
skills_to_grow: Conduct the quality program. Do not treat a checklist title as the result.
Procure a part only when the demand and the part are both identified.
Draw and design in the tool. The tool's runtime is not this labour.
role.ambitious_version: Quality work, procurement, drawings, and schematics stay with the technician. Stored rows only show what was already written.
